description: No mod manager, the overview-issues tree without its F4SE folder (so the Address Library is a File Not Found problem whose path and parent are both missing, with a Nexus link) and with 60 + 45 SADD records appended to two enabled modules (a Race Subgraph Record Count problem with a file list). An Overview Issues + Race Subgraphs scan, then every result selected in turn: the details pane's rows, its clickable path (a file opens its folder, a folder opens itself, a missing path is unbound with X_cursor), its solution text and link clicks, its buttons, Copy Details (the clipboard, Copied! for 3 s, which outlasts the next selection) and the File List window.

deviations.reason: Race Subgraphs counts each enabled module once, so ccDup.esm (in both Fallout4.ccc and plugins.txt) makes 105 SADD Records from 2 modules, listed once.
A HEDR version is matched to MODULE_VERSION_SUPPORT by value, so Legacy170.esp's problem names Skyrim LE, Skyrim VR and Skyrim SE as the games supporting v1.7.
